newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEICESTER CITY FOOTBALL CLUB PLANS FLOAT - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEICESTER CITY FOOTBALL CLUB PLANS FLOAT - PAPER.

text.p: Leicester City football club is set to float its shares on the stock market, a move expected to value the English premier league side at about 40 million pounds ($64.2 million), The Sunday Telegraph reported.
The newspaper said Leicester, which is currently in the middle of the premier league table and has reached the Coca Cola Cup final, is poised to write to existing shareholders about the plan.
Victory in the Coca-Cola final next month, its first cup final in 28 years, would qualify the Midlands club to play in European competition next year.
